A humanoid Tacet Discord born from the abyssal sea that assumes the semblance of an aristocratic merchant, a fully differentiated form of Primordia Bloom.
In its earliest state, the Abyssal Mercator was no different from a Primordia Bloom, a creature capable of consuming others' frequencies to mimic their forms and seamlessly blend with its prey's kind.
Perhaps it originated from a greedy merchant who underestimated the dangers of the Thorncrown Rises, only to become sustenance for countless nematocysts.|Description when discovered}} ==Trophies== {{Trophies|Abyssal Mercator}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Abyssal Mercator |zhs = 凝水贵族 |zht = 凝水貴族 |ja = アビサル・メルカトル |ko = 메르카토르 귀족 |es = Mercator Abisal |fr = Mercator abyssal |de = Tiefen Merkator }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.0}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
